name: Sorokpolány (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over yellow, charged at the centre with a white panel bearing the municipal arms of Sorokpolány: a crowned blue shield with a white bend, a tower and a yellow lion, above a scroll inscribed SOROKPOLÁNY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Sorokpolány arms with crown and scroll
